zh-Hant: 規則和三島流感一樣，只是蜂箱變成 K 個、天數最多 10⁴ 天。先確定每一天的處理順序。
每天找出「今天康復的蜂」時，不要掃過所有過去的批次，也不要把最近 R 天加總。第 d 天康復的就是 new[i][d − R]，查一次就好。
最高峰在每天更新完確診數之後檢查；用嚴格大於才更新，平手時就會保留最早的那一天。
en: The rules match Flu on Three Islands, but there are K hives and up to 10⁴ days. Get the order of each day right first.
To find today's recoveries, do not scan every past batch or sum the last R days. The bees that recover on day d are exactly new[i][d − R], a single lookup.
Check the peak after updating each day's sick count. Update only on strictly greater, so ties keep the earliest day.
